items.claim: Outline-glyph meshes jitter far from the origin
`meshGradientXml` space-joins colors, so functional-notation colors don't round-trip
items.note: Colors are now written `;`-separated, and the svg reader still reads old space-separated files.

items.claim: Mesh bake is straight alpha under bilinear sampling, giving dark rims at patch edges
items.note: `bakeMesh` now returns premultiplied texels and the GLSL and WGSL shaders no longer multiply again.

items.claim: Composite names are looked up on a plain object, so unknown or inherited names misbehave
items.note: This was a strict call: an unknown name throws a `RangeError` naming it, recorded in `docs/unruled.md` under round fifty-four.

items.claim: `meshFromStops` drops the padded ends, and a hard break or a lone stop at 1 gives an empty mesh
items.note: `meshStops` now trims the pad stops on the way back, so the round trip keeps the stops in place.

items.claim: A mesh patch color that doesn't parse throws out of the render, and a patch with three colors reads an undefined corner
items.note: The renderer skips the patch with a development warning, and the svg reader drops it with a warning.

items.claim: A vector image's first raster is made at its declared size with no cap
A blurred drop shadow's interior is about 70% of its color
items.note: Each layer now has its own opacity: `dropShadowLayers` gains `alphas` and `TextFrame.shadow` carries them, while the old single `alpha` and `opacity` stay as deprecated fields. Text-node shadows in SVG export are fixed too. The renderer and text-tools changesets are `minor`, because `alphas` is new API.

items.claim: `imageStatus` counts as an image read for minted bitmap names only
`readPixels` threw synchronously on a bad rect instead of rejecting
items.note: together with `renderIdsAsync`. The existing test had asserted the synchronous throw and now expects a rejection.
